verdict.rationale: Heap's pricing page lists "Report alerts" as a feature of one plan tier, which is a first-party alerting capability tied to reports. Nothing in the pack describes subscribing to dashboards, delivery channels, or detecting abnormal metric movement. missing for 10: dashboard subscription/scheduled delivery, anomaly or threshold detection on key metrics, alert configuration documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can subscribe to dashboards and get alerted when a key metric moves abnormally
